boost.title: Want more people to see it?
boost.note: Optional extras that put a listing in front of more of the right people. Clearly labeled, priced in USD, and never required to be considered for the directory.

groups.label: Placements
groups.note: A clearly marked spot for a launch, run for a week.

groups.label: One-off services
groups.note: Bought on their own or alongside a placement, charged once.

items.name: Promoted spot
items.description: A clearly labeled promoted position near the top of a relevant category.
items.summary: A single promoted slot near the top of the category your site belongs to, marked as promoted so nobody is misled.
includes: One promoted slot in one category, above the standard listings
A promoted label on the listing, plus a note in the category header
A seven-day run, starting the day it goes live
steps: Submit your site and get it approved like any other listing.
Pick the category you want to stand out in and the week you want.
We position the listing, label it, and send you a short note when the run ends.
items.goodFor: A launch that needs a small, honest lift inside its own category — not a site that wants to shout across the whole directory.

items.name: Homepage spotlight
items.description: A larger featured placement for a launch you want more people to notice.
items.summary: The biggest placement we offer: a labelled feature slot on the homepage, pointing straight at your site for a week.
includes: A labelled feature slot in the homepage's featured row
A direct link to your site plus your icon and one-line description
A seven-day run, with one rotation swap if the artwork needs a fix
steps: Submit your site so we have your name, link, and one-line description on file.
Reserve the week you want — one spotlight runs at a time.
Your slot goes live at the start of the week and stays labeled as a spotlight.
items.goodFor: A launch week, a relaunch, or a site that has no audience yet and needs its first real visitors.

items.name: Instant verification
items.description: A verified mark for your listing after an automated ownership check.
items.summary: A verified mark on your listing, granted the moment an automated check confirms you control the domain.
includes: A verified badge next to your listing, everywhere it appears
An automated check through a DNS record or a file on your domain
A one-time fee — the mark stays as long as the listing does
steps: Buy the check for a listing you already own.
We show the exact DNS record or file to add — one line, no plugin needed.
The check usually clears in a few minutes; the mark appears immediately after.
items.goodFor: A site that wants the same mark as anyone checked by hand, with no waiting for a person.

items.name: Become a verified site
items.description: A person reviews your site by hand, then your listing keeps the verified mark and moves to the front of future feature and category queues.
items.summary: A hand review of your site by a person, not a script, ending with a verified mark and priority in future feature and category slots.
includes: A human read-through of your site, with brief notes on what we found
The verified mark, plus priority in future feature and category queues
A one-time fee that follows the listing, not the month
steps: Submit your site and mention that you want the hand review.
We look at speed, structure, and whether it respects a visitor's attention.
You get the notes and the mark, usually within a few working days.
items.goodFor: A site that wants a real opinion alongside the badge, and a better chance at the next open placement.

items.name: SEO audit
items.description: A plain-English review of your technical SEO, page speed and on-page basics, returned as a prioritised list of fixes.
items.summary: A plain-English look at how your site is built for search: crawlability, page speed, metadata, and the on-page basics — returned as a list you can work through in order.
includes: A crawl of your main pages, with the errors that actually matter
Page speed and Core Web Vitals numbers for three representative pages
A prioritised list of fixes, each with a line on why it is worth the time
steps: Send the site and anything you already know is broken.
We crawl it, measure it, and read the templates by hand.
You get one document: what to fix first, next, and eventually — no jargon, no upsell.
items.goodFor: A site that ranks nowhere and wants to know which few things to fix first, without hiring anyone.

items.name: Pre-launch checklist
items.description: Everything to run through before launch day: metadata, redirects, analytics, performance and the easy-to-miss details.
items.summary: A run-through of the boring things that break a launch: metadata, redirects, analytics, performance, and the small details nobody remembers until the day after.
includes: A checklist written for your stack, not a generic PDF
A pass over metadata, canonical URLs, robots and sitemap behaviour
Analytics, error reporting, and a handful of "did anyone actually test this" items
steps: Share the site and the platforms it runs on before launch day.
We go through the list with you and flag anything that will bite later.
You end up with a ticked-off checklist and a short list of known gaps.
items.goodFor: A first launch, or a rebuild that has to go out on a date you cannot move.

items.name: Top 100 featured-on cards
items.description: A ready-made pack of 100 “featured on” badge cards to drop into your product page or footer.
items.summary: A pack of 100 ready-made cards that say your site is featured here — ready to drop into a product page, a press kit, or a footer.
includes: 100 named cards: press mentions, categories, and collections your site sits in
Light and dark versions, plus a plain text list for emails
A one-page guide on where these cards work and where they look like clutter
steps: Pick the collections or categories you want cards for.
We generate the set from your listing and send a zip.
Drop them in wherever your site lists where it has been seen.
items.goodFor: A site with a press page or a marketing footer that looks a little empty.

items.name: Get listed on 20 other directories
items.description: We submit your site to 20 hand-picked directories and launch platforms, so you start with a spread of quality listings.
items.summary: We submit your site to 20 hand-picked directories and launch platforms and keep a record of every one, so the first month of distribution is not your problem.
includes: Submissions to 20 directories we have actually used, not a scraped list
A copy of your submission text, so you can reuse it on the remaining ones
A sheet tracking where each submission went and what is still pending
steps: Send the name, link, one-line description and any assets you have.
We submit to the first 20 and note which ones ask for a fee.
You get the tracking sheet plus the remaining list, so you can keep going yourself.
items.goodFor: A launch week when you would rather spend the time on the product than on twenty submission forms.
